sections.h2: Installed grid battery storage reached about 9.3 GWh by June 2026

chart.title: Installed capacity: 1.08 GWh at end-2025, 5.9 GWh in March, 9.3 GWh in June
chart.source: Mercom India tracking, as reported by pv-magazine India and ESS News.

sections.means: Installed capacity grew from a small base, with 8.2 GWh added in the first half of 2026 alone, against 98.4 MWh in H1 2025.
sections.todo: The Central Electricity Authority should publish a quarterly storage dashboard in GW and GWh, so market size comes from one official series.

sections.h2: Discovered standalone BESS tariffs fell from 10.83 to 1.48 lakh/MW/month

chart.title: Tariffs fell almost in a straight line from the 2022 pilot to late 2025
chart.sub: Standalone BESS capacity-charge tariffs by tender date, ₹ lakh/MW/month.
chart.source: Secondary-press reports of named tenders; IEEFA and JMK Research (May 2026).
ref: If tariffs had fallen only as fast as pack costs (-36.5%), 2022-2025

sections.means: Discovered tariffs fell faster than battery costs, and the tenders are not like-for-like because duration and VGF status differ across rows.
sections.todo: SECI and state utilities should publish every BESS auction in one format, with tariff, duration, cycles, VGF status and winners, so declines compare like for like.

sections.h2: Tariffs fell roughly twice as fast as battery pack costs, 2022 to 2025

chart.title: Every tariff comparison from the 2022 pilot shows a steeper fall than pack costs
chart.sub: Percentage fall from the same starting point. Pack-cost fall is 2022-2025.
chart.source: IEEFA and JMK Research (May 2026); Mercom and secondary-press tender results.
chart.accent: Tariff, Aug 2022 to Dec 2025 record low
rows: Tariff, Aug 2022 to Jan 2025 VGF tender
Tariff, Aug 2022 to Dec 2025 record low

sections.means: Discovered tariffs fell 71% to 86% from the 2022 pilot, against 36.5% for battery pack costs, which IEEFA and JMK read as aggressive bidding rather than cost deflation.
sections.todo: Track the tariff-to-pack-cost gap on each new tender, since IEEFA and JMK estimate up to 75% of 2025's two-hour awards sit below viability.

sections.h2: Only 1.4 GWh of the 40 GWh awarded under the ACC PLI is commissioned

chart.title: ACC PLI: 1.4 GWh commissioned against 40 GWh awarded and a 50 GWh target
chart.sub: Advanced chemistry cell manufacturing capacity, GWh.
chart.source: IEEFA headline framing (October 2025); later data point dated 31 May 2026.

sections.means: Commissioned capacity is 3.5% of the 40 GWh awarded, and India's actual lithium-ion cell capacity was only around 1 GWh at the end of 2025.
sections.todo: The Ministry of Heavy Industries should publish ACC PLI awards and commissioning by firm every quarter, against each firm's milestone dates.
